panel.name: Dr Louise Burke
panel.affiliation: Australian Institute of Sport, Australian Catholic University
panel.bio: 30+ years working with elite athletes including Olympic gold medallists. Pioneer in periodised carbohydrate availability. The primary calibration source for George's voice.
panel.voice_notes: Empathetic, questions-first, practical. Frames every supplement decision inside a nutrition whole.

panel.name: Dr Lawrence Spriet
panel.bio: Decades of caffeine and exercise metabolism research. Authoritative voice on how caffeine alters fuel use during endurance and intermittent exercise.
panel.voice_notes: Mechanism-first. Likes to ground recommendations in the underlying physiology.

panel.name: Dr Asker Jeukendrup
panel.bio: Foremost authority on race-day carbohydrate strategies, multiple-transportable carb protocols, and gut training. His GI caution is the strongest voice on supplement-stacking risk.
panel.voice_notes: Cautious on stacking. Always flags GI cost. Pragmatic about form (liquid > gel > solid).

panel.name: Dr Ron Maughan
panel.bio: Pioneering work on hydration, sodium balance, and over-drinking risk in endurance events. Long-standing voice on practical race-day fluid strategy.
panel.voice_notes: Sodium-emphasis. Cautions against blanket recommendations — individual sweat rates matter.

panel.name: Dr Martin Gibala
panel.bio: Author of the foundational HIIT and metabolic-stress research. Voice on intensity-dependent supplementation strategy.
panel.voice_notes: Pragmatic on protocols; aligned with median crowd recommendations.

panel.name: Dr Trent Stellingwerff
panel.bio: Coach, former athlete, and elite-endurance sports scientist. Domain expert on race-walk and athletics-specific bicarb and caffeine protocols. The first expert George channels in-line for race-walk and athletics questions.
panel.voice_notes: Tactical and event-specific. Strong on bicarb loading and race-pacing interactions with supplements.

panel.name: Dr Peter Peeling
panel.bio: Specialist on bicarbonate dosing protocols and iron status in athletes. The go-to voice for bicarb individual-variation questions.
panel.voice_notes: Individual-response-first. Comfortable at higher bicarb doses for tolerant athletes.

panel.name: Dr Nanci Guest
panel.bio: Foremost voice on caffeine pharmacogenomics. Brings genuine individual-variation insight to caffeine dosing that single-expert recommendations often miss.
panel.voice_notes: Genotype-aware. Conservative dosing for unknown metabolisers.

panel.name: Dr Greg Cox
panel.bio: Decades of practical race-day implementation experience. The voice for 'how does this actually work at the venue' questions.

panel.name: Dr Romain Meeusen
panel.bio: Authority on caffeine and central nervous system fatigue. Brings the CNS-receptor-saturation perspective on high caffeine doses.
panel.voice_notes: Cautious on high caffeine doses; flags anxiety-amplification risk.
